pairs.subject: llm-price-book-operations
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/pricing.rs:85 PriceBook indexes variant-encoded model rates, resolves them in deterministic priority order, and builds as-of dated snapshots that protect past event costs from retroactive changes.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/pricing.rs:99 Model key suffixes encode prompt-length tiers (@in>N) and discount lanes (@batch, @flex) in a closed grammar composing one level deep without schema churn.
crates/core/src/pricing.rs:371 Resolves row by strict precedence: lane variant first, then highest exceeded prompt tier threshold, then base rate, with narrow alias fallback and null miss.
crates/core/src/price_row.rs:71 Rows store effective_from, source_url, and verified_at; PriceBookPosture measures book age against the oldest verified row against a configurable staleness budget.
crates/core/src/pricing.rs:209 Price book builds point-in-time snapshots selecting rates in force at event time; past costs are never restated, and unpriced events are ledgered separately.

pairs.registryProposal: The application note in rust--price-resolution-order.md flagged a deviation where PriceBook::rows stamped Utc::now() instead of the seed's verification date. As of M26, PriceBook::rows preserves self.verified_at onto both effective_from and verified_at (pricing.rs:264-266), resolving the historical deviation.
